assertions.name: bar_even_invariant_holds_for_N2_factor
assertions.source: Bar-even kernel invariant (§4(b) formalize-first gate from refuted-class map): the N=2 ladder factor (1 - b²·ℏ_q⁴) = (1 - u²) is the bar-even prototype. Verified: (1) PR #1786 anchor reproduces; (2) b² is bar-symmetric; (3) ℏ_q²(q⁻¹) = q²·ℏ_q²(q) formal scaling holds; (4) bar-asymmetry measure is b²·ℏ⁴·(q⁴-1), vanishing iff q⁴=1 (cyclotomic anchor — matches fibre-level framing); (5) α_EM kernel IS bar-symmetric (consistent with PR #1521 scalar Habiro success); (6) N=2 leading t-Taylor coefficients up to t^3 all vanish (bar-even prototype). Complements PR #1839's QOU.QBeta.recurrence_step: this gates the input kernel; that engine produces the next c_k from it.

description: Verifies the bar-even kernel invariant from prop:q-beta-bar-even-kernel-invariant — the §4(b) formalize-first gate of the refuted-class map. Confirms (1) the N=2 factor (1 - b²·ℏ_q⁴) is the structural bar-even prototype (matches PR #1786); (2) the bar-asymmetry measure under q↦q⁻¹ is b²·ℏ_q⁴·(q⁴-1) — vanishes IFF q⁴=1 (cyclotomic anchor); (3) α_EM is Taylor-bar-even, Q_β trace-difference is not.
